title: Multi-Task Crack Foundation Model for Engineering-Reliable Crack Representation and Topology Preservation in Civil Infrastructure (CrackGeoFM)
mechanism: Frozen visual foundation backbone with frequency-guided crack enhancement and a domain adaptation module, plus one decoder that jointly outputs mask, skeleton and uncertainty.
adaptation: Take the multi-task decoder only: skeleton head (label skeleton dilated 1 px) and aleatoric uncertainty head on the house model; skeleton output drawn at per-source width; uncertainty as a severity / review flag. 5-shot adaptation claim relevant to the E1 few-shot track.
min_experiment: Arm PF + skeleton + uncertainty heads vs PF; metric relF1@2 (CV) and E1 relF1@2; kill if relF1@2 +<0.01 and E1 relF1@2 +<0.03.
evidence: 20 crack datasets: SOTA segmentation, better topology, calibrated uncertainty, few-shot adaptation from 5 labelled images; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: partial: BRIEF 5 frozen foundation probes showed no gain, but the multi-task skeleton/uncertainty decoder was never tried

alt_notes.adaptation: Frozen DINOv3 or SAM2 encoder, 24-class mask head plus crack skeleton head plus aleatoric crack head; uncertainty feeds the severity step and benchmark calibration reporting.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + aleatoric crack head (and optionally frozen-FM variant); baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: crack ECE within 2 px, CV crack IoU unchanged. Kill if ECE not lower.

alt_notes.adaptation: Frozen DINOv3 or SAM2 encoder with adapter, 24-class mask head plus crack skeleton and aleatoric uncertainty heads; uncertainty output feeds the benchmark's severity and post-evaluation step.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + aleatoric crack head (and optional skeleton head); baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: ECE on crack pixels within 2 px, CV crack IoU. Kill if ECE not lower or IoU drops > 0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add a skeleton head (centerline target from our 1-2 px labels) and an uncertainty head to the Dino U-Net arm; uncertainty flags E1 cells for review; skeleton output feeds crack length for severity.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Dino U-Net + skeleton + uncertainty heads vs Dino U-Net alone; crack relF1@2 on CV and E1 recall at matched precision; kill if both gains < 0.01.
